chapter_seo_title: Keke's Parent Projection Crushes an Ancestral God in World of Immortality Ch 485
chapter_meta_description: The projection of Keke's parent appears from inscribed stones and effortlessly defeats the Otherworld Ancestral God Li Huiyou, shocking all witnesses.

og_description: A cool little beast projection manifests and humbles the mighty Ancestral God wielding the Doomsday Heavenly Halberd in a stunning display of pure martial power.
